title: Smart Housing Experience
summary: MBRHE gives a housing-service reduction from 84 to 32 months and faster approvals, but describes the figures as both delivered features and expected benefits. Whether they were achieved is unclear.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: MBRHE gives a housing-service reduction from 84 to 32 months and faster approvals, but describes the figures as both delivered features and expected benefits. Whether they were achieved is unclear. AI is combined with financing, digital processing, shared data, and pre-approved designs.
purpose: Coordinate housing applications, approvals, financing, and construction services.
developer: MBRHE and unnamed private technology vendors

ratings.reason: The source gives 85% faster design approval, which would be a time-saving benefit if realized. It describes the figures both as delivered features and expected benefits, so whether this gain was achieved is unclear.

The stated reduction from 84 to 32 months would materially improve housing-service access if realized. The chapter also calls the figures expected benefits, so whether this gain was achieved is unclear.

ai_role.statement: AI evaluates eligibility and urgency and recommends housing services. Digital document processing, bank integration, pre-approved designs, and other automation also contribute.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Smart Housing Experience

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Shared data and APIs across housing, banking, land, utility, and municipal services
Eligibility records and digital document processing

headline: Dubai housing gains have unclear achieved-versus-expected status
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
